name: PostHog Analytics
description: Open-source product analytics with event tracking, session recordings, feature flags, and A/B testing.

requiredSecrets.name: POSTHOG_API_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: PostHog project API key (safe for frontend use)

requiredSecrets.name: POSTHOG_HOST
requiredSecrets.reason: PostHog host URL (https://app.posthog.com or self-hosted URL)

postInstallNotes:
1. For frontend tracking, install `posthog-js` and initialize with `POSTHOG_API_KEY`.
2. Use `track(userId, 'button_clicked', { page: '/checkout' })` for server-side events.
3. Define feature flags in the PostHog dashboard and use `isFeatureEnabled` for gradual rollouts.
